think_rate._todo: OQ-BOT-THINK: a guess for Shibi, not a design value. A bot farther than far_distance_m from every alive human (downed, dead and spectating humans do not count) decides (targets, goals, fire, weapon) only every far_interval_ticks physics ticks, staggered by player id; movement, look, timers and path following still run every tick. far_interval_ticks 1 or far_distance_m 0 = every bot thinks every tick.

route._todo: OQ-BOT-ROUTE: guesses for Shibi, not design values (M2B1). big_map_radius_m: the brain treats a map as big when the zone's start radius is above it; only big maps get the landmark glide and the gear goal. geared_armor_tier_min: geared = armour of at least this tier and ammo above ammo_low_magazines. landmark_pick_k: the bot picks (seeded) one of the k nearest landmarks with loot. gear_recheck_ticks: how often (director ticks) a bot re-checks that its landmark still has loot it wants. rotate_detour / rotate_margin_s (big maps, while the zone waits): a bot leaves for its zone spot when distance / its class move speed x rotate_detour + rotate_margin_s exceeds the seconds left before the shrink (small maps keep zone_margin_s). hearing_radius_m: an enemy gun shot this close is remembered. hunt_memory_s: a geared bot with nothing in sight walks to the last enemy seen or heard while that is younger than this, else toward the next circle's centre, until within hunt_arrive_m. hunt_requires_gear: false = a bot with no landmark loot left to fetch also hunts even when not geared (as built and measured in M2B1; confirmed by Shibi, Nov 15 2026); true = only geared bots hunt. Hunt pace (M2B2, big maps only; GUESSES for Shibi, OQ-BOT-ROUTE): hunt_speed_scale: while hunting or regrouping a bot walks at this fraction of its speed (clamped in code to 0.3..1 so the scale alone cannot trip the stuck check; the unstick sidestep stays at full speed); 1.0 = off. hunt_edge_frac: with no fresh enemy memory a hunting bot patrols the next circle's rim at this fraction of its radius instead of walking to its centre, starting at the bot's own zone-spot angle and stepping hunt_patrol_step_deg around (one way for even ids, the other for odd) each time it gets within hunt_arrive_m of a waypoint, so it never stops to hold; 0.0 = off (the centre, as before). hunt_delay_s: for this many seconds after landing and after the last think with an enemy in sight the bot does not follow its enemy memory but regroups (goal regroup) toward the centre or rim point; 0.0 = off. Targets (guesses, x1.0 timings): solo and squads matches 20-40% longer than the M2B2 baseline (3-seed mean), squads not ending in zone phase 1, zone deaths not above the baseline, hold share under 0.15. Measured (M2B2, 1 km sim, tiro, x1.0, mean match length over seeds 99 / 7 / 23 solo and 199 / 107 / 123 squads; the final circle closes at 570 s, so +20% on the solo baseline cannot be reached): baseline (M2B1 values) 499 / 434 s; after the M2B2 accuracy change with the hunt as in M2B1 304 / 243 s; rim 0.8 only 354 / 352; delay 20, speed 0.7, rim 0.8: 359 / 313; delay 60, speed 0.5: 384 / 372 (hunt_memory_s 8 on top: 385 / 350, no gain, so it stays 20); delay 120, speed 0.4: 406 / 382; the shipped delay 60, speed 0.3, rim 0.8: 464 / 393, no squads match ending in zone phase 1. The matches are still 7% / 10% shorter than the baseline: the target is not met.

fight._todo: OQ-BOT-FIGHT: GUESSES for Shibi, not design values (M2B1 / M2B2, big maps only). sight_by_weapon: the bot's sight with that gun in hand (clamped to the gun's range_m; other weapons use sight_range_m). A gun bot with a standing enemy in sight closes in while farther than band_far_frac x that sight (the far edge). Between band_near_frac x sight (the near edge) and the far edge it strafes strafe_step_m to one side plus strafe_step_m x band_push_frac toward the enemy (0 = pure sideways), so it works its way in; at or inside the near edge it strafes in place (sideways only); band_near_frac >= band_far_frac makes the whole sight the near zone. Sides flip about every strafe_period_s x (1 +- strafe_jitter_frac) (seeded per bot; the strafe point is fixed for the period); strafe_step_m 0 = stand still. While closing in, the walk goal moves to the enemy only once the enemy is more than repath_m from it. Aim settle (M2B2): while a bot keeps the same visible target its aim-error limit falls linearly from the profile's error to settle_floor_frac of it over settle_s seconds (settle_s 0 = no settle), resetting on any target change; a target moving at settle_speed_ref_mps or faster does not settle (slower ones in proportion), and the settle only fully applies at settle_range_ref_m or farther (nearer targets in proportion), so bots do not turn into lasers up close. Targets (guesses, profile tiro, x1.0 timings): gun hit rate at 40 m and beyond between 0.10 and 0.25, some gun kills at 40 m or more in both modes, overall gun hit rate not below the baseline. Measured history (1 km sim, profile tiro, aim error about +-7.8 deg, no settle): sight 80 / 120 with band_far_frac 0.7 made fights worse (solo gun hit rate 0.086 -> 0.039, more blade kills and zone deaths); 60 / 60 with 0.25 (band edge 15 m) matched or beat the baseline, so M2B1 shipped 60 / 60 and 0.25. M2B2 measured (x1.0, seeds 99 solo / 199 squads; hit rate at 40-80 m solo / squads, overall solo / squads): floor 0.2, speed ref 8, range ref 40: 0.055 / 0.063, 0.090 / 0.085; range ref 25: 0.059 / 0.099, 0.115 / 0.129; range ref 25 with speed ref 40: 0.131 / 0.076, 0.201 / 0.142; the shipped floor 0.15, speed ref 20, range ref 25: 0.138 / 0.100, 0.198 / 0.155; Sagittarii sight 200 instead of 120 lowered the rate at 40 m and beyond in solo (0.088) and spent shots at 80 m and more (0.026 / 0.063), so 120 stays.
